With the dipped headlamps switched on (stable position) or in the flashing mode, when the stalk unit ring nut is operated, the main beam headlamps do not work

Results of the tests

1

CHECK WITH EXAMINER DIAGNOSTIC INSTRUMENT

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Connect the EXAMINER diagnostic equipment to the diagnostic socket.

Check that there are no faults in the Body Computer

Continue to Step 2

Main beam headlamps relay short circuit to +V Battery

Restore connections See E2012

2

CHECK INDIVIDUAL LIGHTS

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Check the condition of individual bulbs and light units.

Continue to Step 3

Bulbs damaged

Replace bulbs Op. 5540B22

Light unit faulty

Repair or change the front light unit Op. 5540B79

3

MAIN BEAM HEADLAMPS ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT CHECK

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Check, in order:

  • left and right main beam headlamp fuses;
  • connection between steering column switch unit and Body Computer;
  • connection between Body Computer and junction unit;
  • connections between junction unit and bulbs;
  • bulb earth See E2012

Continue to Step 4

Blown fuses

Replace the fuses, then search for the cause of the problem

Connections not correct

Restore connections See E2012

Bulb earth faulty

Restore the earth to the bulbs See E2012

4

CHECK ON BODY COMPUTER

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Check that the Body Computer is supplied properly

Check that when an earth signal from stalk unit to Body is activated, an earth signal is emitted from the Body to drive the dipped beam headlamps relay

Continue to Step 5

Incorrect supply

Restore the supply See E2012

Body Computer faulty

Replace the Body Computer Op. 5505A32

5

STEERING COLUMN SWITCH UNIT CHECK

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Check that the stalk unit is working properly; in particular check the side lights switch

Continue to Step 6

Stalk unit faulty

Replace the steering column switch unit Op. 5550A12

6

CHECK ON CORRECT OPERATION

All OK

Problems met

Operation

Check that the fault is no longer present

Fault persists

Search for the fault starting from another symptom'
